scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:backend && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node electron/dev-launcher.cjs"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: npm run build:backend && vitest run && node --test electron/*.test.cjs tests/backend/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && node tests/electron-smoke.mjs && node tests/electron-phase2.mjs
